P2Follow.description: followVersion 0 means the relation never existed; unfollow keeps and increments the version.

P2RecipientsRequest.description: First page (no cursor) captures or reuses one cut per channelId/sessionId; later pages read only that cut.

P2EventChannelFollowChanged.description: Consumers keep the highest followVersion per aggregate and discard older or equal versions.

available.description: false while the channel owner is suspended (SPEC-20 CA-09); the record stays but its link must not be offered.

P2Preferences.description: Email and push are off by default (version 1); the inbox is always on.

P2ChannelPreference.description: A medium is used for a channel only when both the general switch and this channel switch are on.

P2EventNotificationDeliveryRequested.description: A pointer to one delivery row; the worker reads the address or device at send time. Routing key suffix = lower-case medium.

P2EmailTarget.description: Private; read only at delivery time and never stored by Notifications.

sessionStartMs.description: Offset from the authoritative first LIVE clock; only the session's initial source generation may include up to 120000 ms of retained PREPARING media before zero, without a discontinuity. Source generations are monotonic per stream and need not start at 1. Public timeline intervals remain nonnegative.

P2Timeline.description: Compacted VOD mapping. Media before the first interval is a retained PREPARING prefix without Chat messages; session offset zero maps to the first interval mediaStartMs. Subsequent intervals cover all remaining media through durationMs.

initialSourceGeneration.description: Immutable first source generation assigned to this session. It is preserved across reconnects and must not exceed sourceGeneration. Generations are monotonic per stream, not reset for each session.

sessionStartMs.description: Offset from the authoritative first LIVE clock; only the session's initial source generation may include up to 120000 ms of retained PREPARING media before zero, without a discontinuity. Source generations are monotonic per stream and need not start at 1. Public timeline intervals remain nonnegative.

P2ChatBlockCommand.description: TEMPORARY requires one fixed duration; PERMANENT has no duration and lasts until removed. The server computes expiresAtUtc; the last write wins.

P2ChatBlock.description: version 0 means never blocked; lifting keeps and increments the version. active follows server time.

P2ChatRemoval.description: Repeating a removal returns the original mark. The text is not kept.

P2ChatHistory.description: P2 shape of the P1 chat.history response (ChatHistory stays open to these fields). items and removedMessages cover the same sequence window.

P2ChatMessageRemovedFrame.description: WebSocket frame. A removal is terminal: a later or replayed message.created never restores the text.

P2ChatBlockedError.description: ChatError variant for a blocked account; blockedUntilUtc is present only for TEMPORARY.

P2ChatRemovalCommand.description: Removes the account's messages of that broadcast only, up to the sequence observed when the order is accepted.

P2ChatModerationContext.description: Core confirms a current session whose account owns the channel. Chat requests one per moderation operation and never caches it.
